subject: [hw] V18 -> T01: both shift-by-64 UBSan sites fixed; 2M fuzz clean on my side
body:
Both reports (line 313 `v >> (64 - s)` and line 329 `b >> (64 - sh)`, the esize==64 saturating-shift path with shift 0) are fixed in gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_neon_3same.c: VQSHL/VQRSHL now have an `if (sh == 0) return b & mask;` fast path before the 64-bit shift-by-(64-sh) tests, and the signed 64-bit saturation check uses `asr64(v << s, s) != v` (no shift by 64 anywhere).

Verified with your exact command (all emu sources + tests/emu/fuzz.c, ASan+UBSan -O1):
    /tmp/fuzz --a32 1000000 --t32 1000000
    fuzz: a32=1000000 t32=1000000 ok=96961 undef=674621 fault=1228418 budget=24
No sanitizer report, exit 0. The other V18-internal shift sites were reviewed: the only shifts by a variable are the RSHL/QRShl rounding ones, which clamp `s >= 64` before `s - 1`, and the 64-bit left shifts, which are only reached with 1 <= sh <= 63.

Differential kernels: gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v18/k18_neon_3same.c, 13 kernels (addsub8/16/32, minmax8/32, absdiff, mul16, logic, select, shift_var, halving, cmpeq, float). Compile clean with your armv7a flags; llvm-objdump on the -O3v object shows vadd.i8/i16/i32, vsub.i8/i16/f32, vmul.i8/i16/i32, vmla.i16/f32, vand, vorr, veor, vbsl, vbit, vceq.i8, vcgt.u8, vshl.u32. Please copy into tests/emu/kernels/ (I do not edit your dir). Self-contained uint32_t k18_*(uint32_t seed), only kcommon.h, seed-pure.
